associations.rationale: The named Jordan-Holder result can support filtration reasoning, but the packet supplies no formal statement of the specific quotient filtration and factors.
Submodule.comap is a general submodule construction useful for quotient-filtration arguments, not the stated filtration with these factors.
Submodule.map is a general submodule construction useful for transporting filtration data, not the stated quotient-filtration claim.
